API_UTC_CONTRACT.applies_to: datasets collected by quantmt5.collector through the MT5 Python API (copy_rates_range / copy_ticks_range)

API_UTC_CONTRACT.verification_path: collector records a clock probe (latest tick time vs local UTC at collection); a human/Codex review of that probe is required before any status upgrade
API_UTC_CONTRACT.override_rule: a different clock_profile on an API_UTC_CONTRACT dataset is rejected unless override_reason is recorded (prevents double offset)

LEGACY_CACHE_HYPOTHESIS.basis: per-dataset recorded basis is preserved verbatim; the applied clock_profile is a research hypothesis, not a verified mapping
